_comment: Valuation assumptions for the WACC / DCF / DDM section. Owned by the finance team: review and update at least twice a year. Rates are decimals (0.0514 = 5.14%). Keys are the company's reporting currency.

equity_risk_premium._source: Damodaran, Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums (January 2026 update): China 5.14%, Hong Kong 5.01%, United States 4.46% total equity risk premium; mature-market ERP 4.23%. https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/ctryprem.html

_explicit_years_note: 10 since run 2 (12 Nov 2026; was 5): after the consensus years the growth above terminal growth halves each year, so year 10 sits within about a point of terminal growth and the terminal value is a smaller share of EV. The reverse DCF holds the consensus years and solves for the later ones.
_min_spread_note: DCF/DDM are not shown when the discount rate (WACC or cost of equity) is less than this far above terminal growth: the terminal value explodes. Low risk-free rates (China 10Y) plus low measured betas can trigger this; the finance team may prefer a normalised risk-free rate or a beta floor.
